# hi-cross-artifact-validation: hướng dẫn

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Kiểm tra nhất quán chỉ-đọc giữa các output discovery: ID ổn định, actor/auth, state lifecycle, schema; không sửa artifact nguồn.

**Mô tả gốc (EN):** Validate consistency across discovery outputs (use-case, API, data-model, behavior, command-spec) by checking stable ID resolution, actor/auth alignment, state-transition lifecycle matches, schema compatibility, and cross-domain evidence coherence. Use after leaf discovery skills complete, before refinement.
